requirements.requirement: Keep the installed curl package at its current version during system updates.
requirements.summary: curl remained at 0:8.9.1-5.el10, an exact version lock was active, and DNF exposed no curl update with the lock enabled while showing 8.12.1 when the plugin was disabled. The package and lock persisted after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel, using software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The node remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 before and after the work and restart. The installed versionlock plugin came from the EL10 repository and operated successfully.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied. The mandatory node restart protocol is also strong: it records a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, an observed disconnect, a changed boot identity, and recovered system, curl, version-lock, platform, socket, and package-health state. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: No complete system-update transaction was executed; hold behavior was instead demonstrated directly through DNF update resolution with the versionlock enabled and disabled.

The restart evidence does not identify separate application data or cluster state, but this single-node package-management task defines neither; task-specific curl and version-lock state and general node health were recovered.

operational_hygiene.summary: The package installation, version-lock configuration, metadata refreshes, and restart all had clear roles in implementing or verifying the requested outcome and mandatory restart protocol. No failed services, new network exposure, or package inconsistency was observed. Two small diagnostic files were unnecessarily left in /tmp: /tmp/curl-check.out from cmd-212010ca84684d1f and /tmp/curl-check-post.out from cmd-3bb775c90c1c4644. They remained at final collection rather than being cleaned up. No other unnecessary mutations are evident.
